name: Scenario Planning
description: Explore materially different futures using drivers, uncertainties, scenarios, signposts, option testing, and trigger-based strategy rather than a single forecast in a nicer suit.

tasks.name: Define focal decision
tasks.objective: Specify the decision, planning horizon, system boundary, stakeholders, current strategy, irreversible commitments, and what uncertainty matters enough to change action.

tasks.name: Map forces and uncertainties
tasks.objective: Identify structural trends, constraints, actors, dependencies, weak signals, predetermined elements, and critical uncertainties. Document evidence and competing interpretations.

tasks.name: Construct distinct scenarios
tasks.objective: Create a small set of internally coherent futures spanning the most consequential uncertainties. Make causal chains explicit and avoid four versions of the same baseline.

tasks.name: Analyze implications
tasks.objective: For each scenario, trace effects on demand, operations, capabilities, economics, regulation, technology, stakeholders, risks, and opportunities.

tasks.name: Stress-test strategic options
tasks.objective: Evaluate current strategy and candidate options across scenarios, identifying robust moves, hedges, contingent bets, no-regret actions, and assumptions that fail.

tasks.name: Define signposts and triggers
tasks.objective: Create observable indicators, monitoring cadence, thresholds, ownership, and pre-agreed actions for recognizing which scenario dynamics are emerging.
